subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: Off-Platform Tracking
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Off-Platform Tracking.

hook.text: You're not on Facebook right now. Facebook is still tracking what websites you visit.

buildup.text: The Facebook Pixel is embedded on millions of websites, sending your browsing activity back to Meta.

discovery.text: Like buttons, login widgets, and analytics scripts let platforms follow you across the entire web.

twist.text: Even if you don't click 'Like,' the button loads and reports that you visited that page.

climax.text: Social media doesn't stop watching when you leave the app. It follows you across the internet.

punchline.text: Log out of Facebook. It never logs out of you.

quiz.question: How does the Facebook Pixel track users off the platform?
options: It's embedded on millions of websites and reports browsing activity to Meta
It only tracks users who are logged in to Facebook
